parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH 8 (val_bpb 1.019783) as it regressed from my best (1.009491 at DEPTH 6). Increasing depth from 6 to 8 with the current LR/batch seems to have hit a stability wall or caused suboptimal convergence within the 5-minute budget. Reverting to DEPTH 6 and will try adjusting MATRIX_LR or WEIGHT_DECAY instead.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH 6 and testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.05) combined with WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if we can improve upon the 1.009491 baseline.
